title: Legislation
description: A law, ordinance, resolution, or a numbered part of a code. This is the abstract work, not a file of it - the text itself lives in one or more LegislationObjects. schema.org's legislation vocabulary derives from the European Legislation Identifier, so almost everything needed here already exists and this profile mints only a codification level. Structural markup inside the text (clauses, provisos, amendment instructions) is out of scope by design: that is what Akoma Ntoso is for, linked through encoding.

legislationIdentifier.description: The citation as the jurisdiction writes it - 'Ordinance 2025-15', 'Chapter 17.40', an ELI or CELEX URI.

legislationType.description: termCode from the LegislationType code list.

codificationLevel.description: Which structural tier of a code this is. hasPart nests parts but never says what kind of part, which is the one gap in schema.org's legislation vocabulary.

position.description: Ordering among siblings. Real schema.org CreativeWork property.

enactedAt.description: The Meeting at which it was adopted. This is the join to the meetings profile, and the reason the two are built together.

legislationDateOfApplicability.description: When it becomes applicable, which can differ from entry into force.

legislationDateVersion.description: The point in time this description of the legislation is valid for. This is how consolidated codes express versioning, and the hardest part of publishing a municipal code correctly.

legislationLegalForce.description: Real schema.org property with a real enumeration. Do not invent a status field.

isPartOf.description: The parent tier: a section's chapter, a chapter's title.

encoding.description: The actual files. Attach the Akoma Ntoso XML here.

keywords.description: Subject keywords. Not schema:about, which ranges over Thing and is for references to entities - free-text strings there expand as relative IRIs.
